input.text:
Subject: Your Q3 churn note

Hi Sarah,

Your Q3 update said 40% of customer losses happen in the first month. That's usually an onboarding problem, not a product one.

We helped Brightwave, a payroll SaaS about your size, cut first-month churn from 38% to 21% in one quarter by adding a day-7 check-in call and a three-step setup guide. Nothing to install.

With renewals coming up in January, fixing month one now would protect next year's numbers.

If it's useful, I can send the two-page playbook we used. Just reply "send it". No call needed.

Tom
